Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan in the center lane of a multi-lane roadway in Pasadena, Texas, and attempted to
move into the adjacent lane when the right side of the vehicle made contact with the left side of a pickup truck
opreated by Dirver 2. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee following the impact. Driver 2 stated that the collision
occurred as Driver 1 changed lanes without signaling, and two independent wintesses at the scene gave statements
consistent with that account. Photographs taken at the scene show scrape marks and displaced trim along the
sideswipe area of both vehicles. A passenegr was seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's sedan and was confirmed
present by Driver 1, Driver 2, and both witnesses. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the
sedan. Officers observed no prior damage to the sedan, and none was reported by Driver 1 or Driver 2. The knee
injury described is consistent with the forces expected from a side impact of this type. Some of the visible damage to
the rear quarter panel of the sedan could not be clearly attributed to this impact and may require further inspection by
a qualified appraiser.
